card.name: Linking words in long clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, the, with, commas, including) in the middle of a clause, often after an assembly or after concomitant use of benzodiazepines or CNS depressants. The pattern is loose.

modes.label: History prose
modes.description: Of and the inside a sentence about a political pamphlet and the States General.
modes.example: demanded an assembly<< of>> the States General from which the royal officers

modes.label: Drug interaction lists
modes.description: A comma or including after benzodiazepines or CNS depressants in interaction text.
modes.example: Concomitant use of benzodiazepines<<,>> including Midazolam in Sodium Chlor
